facts.fact: ISO's member record states the Somali Bureau of Standards is a national standards body established by an Act of parliament (the Somali Standards and Quality Control law, Lr27) and operational since early 2020; the record gives no date, so the published date 2026-08-29 is used for the state of affairs.

systems.owner: Federal Republic of Somalia, board of ministry, Chamber of Commerce and agency representatives

note: No fact on certification: the bureau's mandate lists quality certificates and marks for goods and food, not certification against an IT or data standard, and names no certifier; no national IT or data standard is named.

systems.tiers: public- and private-sector critical infrastructure organisations

note: Regulator-issued cybersecurity frameworks (the post cites ISO/IEC 27001 only in the linked PDFs), not national standards issued by a standards body, and no certifier is named; recorded as other.

Passages cover only NCA telecom equipment type approval (a telecom regulator rule, class other); they state no national standards body, no national IT or data standard and no certification against one.
No national standards body, standard or certification stated.

facts.fact: The US International Trade Administration says the Somali Bureau of Standards is the national standards body, responsible for developing and implementing standards, and has adopted 145 standards in various fields over three years.
HoA DRIVE Somalia describes the Somali Bureau of Standards as overseeing quality and compliance services for goods in Somalia, with a searchable catalogue of national standards on its new platform.

note: No information technology or data standard and no certification against one is named.
